mapper.select: select m.id, m.conversation_id conversationId, m.from_user_id fromUserId, m.content, m.msg_type msgType, m.is_read isRead, m.create_time createTime, case when m.from_user_id = 0 then '系统消息' else u.nickname end fromNickname, u.avatar fromAvatar from message m left join user u on m.from_user_id = u.id where m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by m.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select m.id, m.conversation_id conversationId, m.from_user_id fromUserId, m.content, m.create_time createTime, p.title productTitle, fu.nickname fromNickname, u.nickname otherNickname from message m join conversation c on m.conversation_id = c.id left join product p on c.product_id = p.id left join user u on u.id = if(c.buyer_id = #{userId}, c.seller_id, c.buyer_id) left join user fu on m.from_user_id = fu.id where (c.buyer_id = #{userId} or c.seller_id = #{userId}) and m.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') order by m.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from message m join conversation c on m.conversation_id = c.id where (c.buyer_id = #{userId} or c.seller_id = #{userId}) and m.content like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
